company.name: Applied Intuition
company.shortDescription: Applied Intuition provides software infrastructure to safely develop, test, and deploy autonomous vehicles  at scale.
company.description: Applied Intuition is the vehicle intelligence company that accelerates the global adoption of safe, AI-driven machines. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion following its recent Series F funding round, Applied Intuition delivers the Vehicle OS, Self-Driving System, and toolchain to help customers build intelligent vehicles and shorten time to market. 18 of the top 20 global automakers and major programs across the Department of Defense trust Applied Intuition's solutions to deliver vehicle intelligence. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining, and agriculture industries and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Diego, CA, Ft. Walton Beach, FL, Ann Arbor, MI, London, Stuttgart, Munich, Stockholm, Bangalore, Seoul, and Tokyo.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform for developing, deploying, updating, and validating vehicle software across domains, with APIs, SDKs, AI capabilities, and support for onboard and offboard applications.
productsAndServices.name: Vehicle OS

productsAndServices.description: A modular autonomy software stack for integrating and deploying automated-driving capabilities in automotive, trucking, mining, and construction vehicles.
productsAndServices.name: Self-Driving System (SDS)

productsAndServices.description: An integrated toolchain for designing, developing, testing, and validating ADAS, automated-driving, and general vehicle software using simulation, data infrastructure, AI agents, and software testing.
productsAndServices.name: Tools for Vehicle Intelligence

productsAndServices.description: A simulation tool for modeling objects and behaviors used to evaluate autonomous-vehicle perception, prediction, planning, and control systems.
productsAndServices.name: Object Sim

productsAndServices.description: A sensor simulation product for generating virtual sensor inputs used to develop and test perception and autonomous-driving systems.
productsAndServices.name: Sensor Sim

productsAndServices.description: A log-based testing tool that replays recorded vehicle data to evaluate autonomy and vehicle software against real-world driving situations.
productsAndServices.name: Log Sim
